features.name: Choose accelerometer
features.description: Lets the user pick which accelerometer (Standard / etc.) is used by the other scenarios via a ComboBox.
expected_behaviour: A 'Standard' selection ComboBox is shown under the description text.
Description reads 'Choose the accelerometer to be used by the other scenarios.'

features.name: Data events
features.description: Registers a ReadingChanged event handler and displays X/Y/Z acceleration as reported. Enable/Disable buttons start/stop the subscription.
expected_behaviour: Enable and Disable buttons are present.
Output region shows acceleration values (or 'No data' / not-found status when no sensor is present).

features.name: Shake events
features.description: Registers a Shaken event handler and shows a cumulative shake count. Enable/Disable buttons control the subscription.
expected_behaviour: Enable and Disable buttons are present.
Shows 'Shake count: 0' and a status line ('Standard accelerometer not found' when no sensor).

features.name: Polling
features.description: Polls the accelerometer at a set interval and displays the X/Y/Z values. Enable/Disable buttons start/stop the timer.
expected_behaviour: Enable and Disable buttons are present.
Output shows 'No data' until polling produces readings; status line shown.

features.name: Orientation change
features.description: Uses the ReadingTransform property to show accelerometer readings with and without display-orientation transformation.
expected_behaviour: Enable and Disable buttons are present (disabled when no sensor).
Shows 'Untransformed:' and 'Transformed to DisplayOrientation:' sections, each 'No data' without a sensor.
Red status bar reads 'Standard accelerometer not found' when no sensor present.

features.name: Data events batching
features.description: Registers a ReadingChanged handler with a report-latency (batching) and displays X/Y/Z values as reported.
expected_behaviour: Enable and Disable buttons are present.
Output shows acceleration values / 'No data' and a status line.
